items.summary: The true moral failing lies with the orchestrators, the political elites who exploit this poverty, handing out costumes to the disenfranchised to ensure the "play" goes on flawlessly under the sacred banner of the Youth Pledge.

items.title_zh: 普拉博沃总统和他的前任佐科维之间的分裂背后是什么

items.title: MAGA’s midterm defeat won’t change the course of history
items.title_zh: MAGA的中期失利不会改变历史进程
items.summary: The world must not succumb to euphoria following Donald Trump’s latest defeat. If anything, his lame-duck status deprives Americans and everyone else of an excuse for avoiding hard conversations about the truly radical changes that will be needed to avert future catastrophes.

items.title: Trump says FBI probing Nvidia CEO Huang
items.title_zh: 特朗普称联邦调查局正在调查英伟达首席执行官黄
items.summary: Trump said he "was amazed" by allegations about Huang, among the president's closest allies in Silicon Valley. Trump said he had spoken to the CEO, who told him that he had no idea that the woman was a spy.

items.title: Biodiesel: Don’t move too fast, build the ecosystem first
items.title_zh: 生物柴油：不要走得太快，先构建生态系统
items.summary: Indonesia has ramped up its biodiesel blend to B50 from B30 just in four years, but feedstock, engines, forests and infrastructure have not kept pace. Brazil and Malaysia remind us why sequencing matters.

items.title: Rubio warned Trump about Nvidia CEO's Chinese 'spy' affair months ago. Did he ignore it?
items.title_zh: 几个月前，卢比奥就英伟达首席执行官的中国“间谍”事件向特朗普发出警告。他忽略了吗？
items.summary: US President Donald Trump expressed confidence in Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang regarding allegations of ties to a Chinese spy. Trump stated he believes Huang was unaware of the alleged spy's identity during an FBI investigation. Rubio's memo on Huang's relationships surfaced before Trump's visit to Beijing, indicating prior knowledge of the situation. The FBI is scrutinizing the implications on national security concerning Nvidia's technology and partnerships.

items.title: Why Sonia Gandhi gave up PM post in 2004 despite UPA victory; memoir recalls moment
items.title_zh: 为什么索尼娅·甘地在2004年放弃了总理职位，尽管UPA取得了胜利；回忆录回忆时刻
items.summary: Sonia Gandhi reveals her thoughts in her memoir about declining the prime minister role after the UPA's victory. She describes her inner voice guiding her decision and her conversation with Rahul. Gandhi highlights why she chose Manmohan Singh for the position, noting his integrity and governance experience. Her memoir also covers her personal journey, including significant tragedies and cultural adjustments after moving to India.

items.title: Punjab records 4,657 stubble-burning cases; 1,442 FIRs, Rs 7.28 crore in fines
items.title_zh: 旁遮普省记录了4,657起焚毁胡茬案件； 1,442起FIR ，罚款7.28亿卢比
items.summary: Punjab experienced a total of 4,657 stubble burning incidents reported until November 9, 2026. Police have filed 1,442 FIRs, and environmental fines totaling Rs 7.285 crore were imposed and partially recovered. The district of Tarn Taran had the highest number of incidents with 659 reported cases. Monitoring teams are actively inspecting and addressing stubble burning violations in several districts.

items.title: Why villagers pelt each other with stones in Himachal's 400-year-old tradition
items.title_zh: 喜马偕尔有400年历史的村民为何用石头互相扔石头
items.summary: Dhami village in Himachal Pradesh observes a unique stone-pelting ritual called 'Patthar Ka Khel' after Diwali. This tradition involves two groups of villagers throwing stones at each other until someone gets injured. Following the ritual, blood from the injured participant is offered to Goddess Bhadrakali. The ceremony is thought to have originated as a substitute for human sacrifice to appease the deity.

items.title: 2nd marriage, locked house, unanswered calls: Mystery shrouds deaths of Nagpur couple
items.title_zh: 第二次婚姻，上锁的房子，未接电话：神秘笼罩着那格浦尔夫妇的死亡
items.summary: Manish Pralhad Ganveer and Sonali Ganveer were discovered dead at their home in Nagpur after Diwali celebrations. Their bodies were hanging from a ceiling fan and they had been married only in August. Relatives became concerned when they could not reach the couple and sent someone to check on them. Neighbors reported hearing an argument before the house fell silent on Friday afternoon.

items.title: What Nvidia CEO first told world about the woman he has admitted having an affair with
items.title_zh: Nvidia首席执行官首次向世界透露他承认与之有染的女性
items.summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang publicly acknowledged an affair that has raised concerns over his leadership. Following his admission, Nvidia initiated an independent investigation into reports concerning foreign intelligence involvement. Huang expressed remorse for his actions towards his family and colleagues while committing to cooperate with the inquiry. US President Donald Trump commented on the situation, stating that the FBI is investigating the matter.

items.title: Michigan business floods neighbour's basement; court cuts damages to $102,000
items.title_zh: 密歇根州的商业淹没邻居的地下室；法院将损失削减至$ 102,000
items.summary: A Michigan business's drainage changes sent excess rainwater onto a neighbouring property, causing years of flooding and damage to the house and garage. An appeals court revised the homeowner's $170,000 award to $102,000, while upholding $50,000 in emotional distress damages under the nuisance claim.

items.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang loses $7.4bn in 30 minutes, drops 2 spots in Forbes rich list
items.title_zh: 英伟达首席执行官Jensen Huang在30分钟内亏损74亿美元，在福布斯富豪榜中排名下滑2位
items.summary: Nvidia's CEO Jensen Huang faced a notable drop in net worth, tumbling from $162.2 billion to $154.7 billion, following revelations of an ongoing investigation into his supposed involvement with a Chinese spy. The resulting unrest caused Nvidia's shares to plunge by more than 7%, raising alarms about its market stability as broader questions emerge regarding Nokia's dealings in China and their national security ramifications.

items.title: Sandpapergate row: Starc stands by his version despite Warner backing Khawaja
items.title_zh: Sandpapergate ROW ：尽管华纳支持Khawaja ， Starc仍然支持他的版本
items.summary: Mitchell Starc has once again addressed the controversy surrounding the 2018 ball-tampering incident, reaffirming his stance since 2021. Meanwhile, David Warner has backed Usman Khawaja's assertions, labeling them as the truth. He expressed his disappointment over the lack of in-depth scrutiny during Cricket Australia's initial probe. Starc denied any involvement or knowledge of the tampering, insisting that the bowlers were kept in the dark about the matter.

items.title: Work on southern section of inter-Korean railway to resume soon: Seoul
items.title_zh: 朝韩铁路南段工程即将恢复：首尔
items.summary: Vice Unification Minister Kim Nam-jung said Tuesday construction will soon resume on the South Korean section of a railway line meant to link the two Koreas. He made the remarks during a seminar in Seoul, as the government seeks to restore the South Korean section of the Gyeongwon Line, which once connected Seoul and North Korea's eastern port city of Wonsan. The last stop now accessible on the southern section is Cheorwon's Baekmagoji in Gangwon Province, and the ministry plans to resume work on the stretch between Baekmagoji and Woljeong-ri Station, the northernmost station on the South Korean side, close to the Demilitarized Zone (DMZ) separating the two Koreas. The planned restoration work is aimed at "preparing a path connecting the two Koreas," Kim said at the forum on peace tourism cooperation on the Korean Peninsula. Earlier this year, the ministry briefed the National Assembly on its plan to carry out preparatory work within this year, and to resume construction on the cross-border line next year. items.title: Over 3,500 exposed in special crackdown on real estate crimes: police
items.title_zh: 超过3500人在房地产犯罪的特别打击中暴露：警方
items.summary: Police have found 3,565 people suspected of committing real estate-related crimes, with over 2,100 of them referred to the prosecution and 16 formally arrested, police officials said Tuesday. Following its yearlong special crackdown on such crimes that began October 2025, the police referred 2,151 to prosecutors on various charges, including fixing or inflating home prices, and applying for and winning new apartment purchases through fraudulent means, according to the officials. The special crackdown has been extended by one year to the end of October 2027, they said, amid continued government efforts to curb runaway housing prices. Of those exposed in the crackdown, farmland speculation accounted for the largest share at 25.2 percent, or 898 people, followed by 795 people who allegedly used fraudulent means in apartment applications and 726 accused of illegal brokering, such as inflating home prices. Police have frozen 14.79 billion won ($11.02 million) in illegal profits even before formal indictments and notified relevant authorities about 616 people so that punitive administrative ac

items.title: Students from 30 countries gather in Seoul to learn Korean language and culture
items.title_zh: 来自30个国家的学生齐聚首尔，学习韩国语言和文化
items.summary: Ninety-two students and teachers from 30 countries wrapped up a five-day immersive camp hosted by the Ministry of Education. A group of 92 secondary school students and teachers from 30 countries completed a five-day immersive journey into Korean language and culture, concluding a nationwide youth camp organized by the Ministry of Education. To mark the end of the 2026 International Korean Education Youth Camp, the ministry and the International Korean Education Foundation held a celebratory ceremony Tuesday evening at Sarangjae, a traditional guest house on the National Assembly grounds in Seoul. Running from Friday to Tuesday across Seoul and Incheon, the camp brought together students enrolled in Korean language classes at their home schools. This year’s cohort welcomed its first-ever participant from Mexico, alongside students from Malaysia and Uzbekistan who were recently featured in a KBS documentary aired on Hangeul Day, the Oct. 9 national holiday celebrating the Korean alphabet. During the program, participants engaged in level-tailored Korean lessons leveraging artificial int

items.title: Ex-US diplomat says OPCON transfer may not move rapidly, cites 'no consensus' in Washington
items.title_zh: 前美国外交官表示， OPCON转移可能不会迅速进行，理由是华盛顿“没有共识”
items.summary: A former U.S. diplomat said Tuesday that the envisioned transfer of wartime operational control (OPCON) from Washington to Seoul may not move forward swiftly, citing "no consensus" on the key alliance issue in the United States. Speaking virtually at a forum, Joseph Yun, former acting U.S. ambassador to South Korea and special representative for North Korea, also said that there is no consensus in Washington over Seoul's push to secure rights to enrich uranium for peaceful civilian purposes and acquire nuclear submarines. Yun offered his forecasts over what will happen during the remaining two years of U.S. President Donald Trump's administration, particularly in the wake of this month's U.S. midterm elections, in which Democrats won control of both the Senate and the House of Representatives. "I cannot imagine (the OPCON transfer efforts) moving very rapidly," Yun said during the forum hosted by the Korea-U.S. Parliamentarians' Union. "Same thing with nuclear issues. items.title: Seoul plant hospital admits 10,000 potted patients since 2023 opening
items.title_zh: 自2023年开业以来，首尔植物医院接收了10,000名盆栽患者
items.summary: A city-run hospital for houseplants? Welcome to modern Seoul. Seoul’s dedicated emergency room for sickly flora has administered 10,886 diagnoses, treatments and house-call consultations since opening its doors in 2023, the Seoul Metropolitan Government said Tuesday. Nestled inside the Seoul Agricultural Technology Center in Seocho District, the Companion Plant Hospital functions like a full-scale medical center for dramatic greenery. Resident plant doctors diagnose bug infestations and mysterious wilting, prescribing everything from targeted pesticides to emergency repotting. Plants needing intensive care can even be admitted for up to three months of inpatient recovery, while anxious plant parents leave with tailored home-care prescriptions. The hospital often handles high-stakes, emotional cases. In one instance, a resident rushed in a wilting Chinese money tree — the final gift from their late mother. The facility immediately admitted the botanical heirloom into critical care, nursing it back to life. In another success story, a Rhaphidophora tetrasperma — the trendy "mini monst

items.title: Army temporarily grounds Apache helicopters amid US inspection for possible defect
items.title_zh: 在美国检查可能存在的缺陷期间，陆军暂时停飞阿帕奇直升机
items.summary: The Korean Army has temporarily grounded its Apache military helicopters as U.S. authorities began inspections on the fleet over a possible malfunction of their transmission system, an Army official said Tuesday. The grounding of the AH-64E Apache Guardian attack helicopters has been in place since early October, after the Army received a safety advisory from the U.S. military regarding the transmission component, Army spokesperson Capt. Bae Seok-jin said in a press briefing. "As a safety precaution, the Army temporarily grounded the fleet in early October (for the U.S. side) to conduct technical inspections in phases," Bae said. "Operations will resume sequentially based on the inspection results." While routine training flights are paused during the grounding, the helicopters usually stand ready for an immediate operational launch in the event of a contingency. "There are currently no issues with our readiness or operational posture," the Army spokesperson added. items.title: Special counsel suspects NEC forged vote tally sheet in Gyeonggi education chief election
items.title_zh: 特别顾问怀疑NEC在京畿道教育局长选举中伪造了投票记录表
items.summary: A special counsel team said Tuesday it suspects a National Election Commission (NEC) employee concealed and forged a vote tally sheet during the election for education superintendent of Gyeonggi Province in June. Investigators were sent to the Gyeonggi provincial election commission and the election commission in Gwangju, Gyeonggi Province, earlier in the day to execute a search and seizure warrant and verify the suspicions, according to the team led by independent counsel Lee Tae-han. The team suspects the employee of the Gwangju election commission concealed and forged the vote tally sheet, which the local commission sought to cover up, leading to an incorrect final tally. Lee's team has been investigating various suspected irregularities involving the NEC after it was launched in early September to look mainly into what led to the unprecedented ballot shortages in June's nationwide local elections.

items.title: Top court schedules another deliberation for ex-PM's martial law trial, raising likelihood of release
items.title_zh: 最高法院为前总理戒严审判安排了另一次审议，提高了释放的可能性
items.summary: The Supreme Court on Tuesday scheduled another deliberation session on former Prime Minister Han Duck-soo's appeal on insurrection charges, raising the likelihood of his release when his detention period runs out next week. The top court said it would hold the second deliberation round on Han's appeal on Nov. 19, a day before his six-month detention period expires over his role in former President Yoon Suk Yeol's failed martial law bid. Given the schedule, Han, who was sentenced to 15 years in prison by an appellate court, is likely to be released when his detention period runs out as it can no longer be extended. Supreme Court proceedings for Han's appeal have been drawn out after the court referred the case to its full bench in August, citing the public's high interest and its historical importance. A Seoul district court sentenced Han to a 23-year prison term in January after convicting him of multiple charges, including playing a key role in an insurrection under Yoon's short-lived declaration of martial law on Dec. 3, 2024. items.title: PPP urges Lee to veto special counsel bill on alleged fabricated indictments
items.title_zh: PPP敦促Lee就涉嫌捏造的起诉书否决特别顾问法案
items.summary: The main opposition People Power Party (PPP) on Tuesday called on President Lee Jae Myung to veto a recently passed bill on a special counsel investigation into alleged fabricated indictments targeting Lee and others. The PPP made the appeal as they held a general meeting of its lawmakers outside the presidential office, slamming the bill as a measure aimed at canceling all indictments against Lee. "The special counsel bill marks the final step in a project to free Lee Jae Myung from prison," PPP leader Jang Dong-hyeok said. "It is a jailbreak bill designed to get Lee, who should be behind bars, out of jail." The legislation calls for appointing an independent counsel to investigate suspicions the prosecution under former President Yoon Suk Yeol fabricated evidence or induced false testimonies to build cases against then opposition leader Lee and others. "We must resume all trials and make Lee face the judiciary's judgment before his crimes are wiped away," Jang added. Rep. items.title: Lee says Korea will continue cooperation with US administration

items.summary: President Lee Jae Myung said Tuesday that Korea will continue to closely cooperate with the U.S. administration following the recent U.S. midterm elections, while also seeking to expand bipartisan support in Congress for issues related to the country and the alliance. Lee made the remarks at a Cabinet meeting after the opposition Democratic Party in the United States won control of both the Senate and the House of Representatives in last week's midterm elections. "After the U.S. midterm elections, many changes are expected to take place in the external environment," the Korean president said, instructing officials to prepare thoroughly for any possible changes. "Utmost attention should be paid to minimizing negative effects from external uncertainties on the domestic economy." "More important than anything would be strengthening and expanding the foundation for cooperation and trust between the two countries from the mutually beneficial perspective," Lee added, calling for efforts to ensure the implementation of bilateral diplomatic and security agreements. items.title: Air defenses intercept Houthi cruise and ballistic missiles targeting Riyadh
items.title_zh: 防空系统拦截针对利雅得的胡塞巡航导弹和弹道导弹
items.summary: RIYADH — Air defenses intercepted and destroyed a cruise missile launched by the Houthi militia toward Riyadh, the Coalition to Support Legitimacy in Yemen announced Tuesday.The coalition also reported that Saudi air defenses had intercepted a ballistic missile launched by the Houthis toward the capital.Saudi Civil Defense activated an early warning alert in Riyadh, warning residents of a potential threat and urging them to follow official safety instructions.In a separate incident, Saudi air defenses thwarted another ballistic missile launched by the Houthi militia toward the Kingdom's southern region, according to the coalition.The interceptions came shortly after the coalition announced the destruction of a Houthi facility used to assemble and produce ballistic missile components.

items.title: Riyadh deputy emir inspects Saudi Aramco building damaged in Houthi attack
items.title_zh: 利雅得副埃米尔视察在胡塞袭击中受损的沙特阿美大楼
items.summary: RIYADH — Deputy Emir of Riyadh Region Prince Mohammed bin Abdulrahman inspected a Saudi Aramco administrative building in Riyadh on Monday to assess the limited damage caused by a Houthi attack targeting civilian facilities.The visit followed an attempted drone attack on the building Sunday morning, which caused debris to fall onto the premises, resulting in limited damage but no injuries or fatalities, according to the Saudi Ministry of Energy.**media[2792416]**The ministry said the relevant authorities immediately responded to the incident and took the necessary measures.During his inspection, Prince Mohammed said the Houthi attacks reinforced Saudi Arabia's longstanding position regarding the terrorist militia and its targeting of civilian facilities.He praised the efforts of personnel across civilian, military and security sectors in responding to the incident and safeguarding the Kingdom.The deputy emir was briefed on the procedures implemented by Saudi Aramco and the relevant regional authorities following the attack.**media[2792415]**He directed that all necessary resources and support be provided to facilitate the work of Aramco personnel.Prince Mohammed also expressed appreciation for the Saudi leadership's efforts to maintain the Kingdom's security and stability.He highlighted the spirit of national solidarity and the readiness of Saudi forces to confront any threats to the country's security.Several senior security officials from Riyadh Region accompanied the deputy emir during the inspection.

items.title: Canadian PM Carney condemns Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia during call with Crown Prince
items.title_zh: 加拿大总理卡尼谴责胡塞武装在与王储通话期间对沙特阿拉伯的袭击
items.summary: RIYADH — Saudi Crown Prince and Prime Minister Mohammed bin Salman held on Monday a phone call with Prime Minister of Canada Mark Carney.During the call, Carney condemned the terrorist Houthi militia's attacks on Saudi Arabia and affirmed Canada's solidarity with Saudi Arabia against any threats to its security and the safety of its citizens and residents.The leaders also discussed bilateral relations between the two countries and ways to strengthen and develop cooperation across various fields.

items.title: Saudi FM discusses regional situation with his British, French, German and Korean counterparts in Paris
items.title_zh: 沙特外长在巴黎与英国、法国、德国和韩国外长讨论地区局势
items.summary: PARIS — Saudi Minister of Foreign Affairs Prince Faisal bin Farhan held talks with foreign ministers of the United Kingdom, France, Germany and Korea in Paris on Monday. The meetings were held on the sidelines of the Group of Seven (G7) Foreign Ministers' Meeting.During their meeting, Prince Faisal and Secretary of State for Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Affairs of the United Kingdom Ed Miliband reviewed bilateral relations between their countries. They discussed key regional issues and current developments, as well as joint efforts to ensure maritime security, safeguard shipping routes, and restore security and stability in the region.During his meeting with French Minister for Europe and Foreign Affairs Jean-Noël Barrot, Prince Faisal expressed appreciation for France's efforts during its G7 presidency this year and for inviting Saudi Arabia to participate in the ministerial meeting. The ministers discussed recent regional developments, the terrorist Houthi militia's continued attacks on Saudi Arabia, and joint efforts to contain regional crises and mitigate their repercussions. They also discussed efforts to safeguard waterways, ensure freedom of navigation, and maintain regional security and stability. Saudi Ambassador to France Dr. Faisal Al-Mujfel attended the meeting. Prince Faisal bin Farhan also met with Korean Minister of Foreign Affairs Cho Hyun. During the meeting, they reviewed bilateral relations and discussed avenues of cooperation and partnership between the two countries. They also exchanged views on current regional issues and ongoing efforts to address them. The Saudi foreign minister and the German Federal Minister for Foreign Affairs Johann Wadephul reviewed bilateral relations between their countries. They discussed regional developments and diplomatic efforts aimed at maintaining security and stability in the region, ensuring freedom of navigation, and safeguarding maritime routes.

items.title: Saudi Arabia joins G7 Paris talks on harnessing AI for global security
items.title_zh: 沙特阿拉伯加入七国集团关于利用人工智能促进全球安全的巴黎会谈
items.summary: PARIS — Saudi Minister of Foreign Affairs Prince Faisal bin Farhan attended an expanded G7 Session with Invited Partners (G7+) on artificial intelligence (AI) in Paris on Monday.The session discussed the implications of rapid advances in AI technologies and models for the global strategic environment and international security. The meeting also addressed ways to strengthen international coordination in managing AI-related risks while promoting innovation and ensuring the safe and responsible development and use of these technologies to safeguard global security and stability.

items.title: Saudi, Omani foreign ministers discuss regional situation in phone call
items.title_zh: 沙特，阿曼外交部长在电话中讨论地区局势
items.summary: RIYADH — Minister of Foreign Affairs Prince Faisal bin Farhan held a phone call on Monday with Foreign Minister of Oman Sayyid Badr bin Hamad Al Busaidi. During the call, the ministers discussed the regional situation in light of recent developments. They stressed the need to continue diplomatic efforts to contain the crisis, safeguard maritime navigation and shipping routes, and limit the impact of these developments on regional security and stability.

items.title: Container handling at Saudi ports rises 14% in October; Jeddah Islamic Port sets a record
items.title_zh: 10月沙特港口集装箱处理量增长14% ；吉达伊斯兰港创纪录
items.summary: RIYADH — The overall container handling across Saudi ports recorded a 14 percent year-on-year increase during the last month of October, according to Abdullah Al-Munif, spokesperson of the Saudi Ports Authority (Mawani). He said that Jeddah Islamic Port recorded the highest monthly container-handling volume in its history in October 2026, reaching 582,900 TEUs (twenty-foot equivalent units). This marked a 27.45 percent increase over its previous record, set in June.Al-Munif noted that Jeddah Islamic Port's record performance reflects its operational efficiency and advanced logistical capabilities. “The achievement underscores the port's ability to keep pace with the rapid transformations in global trade and accommodate growing trade volumes. This milestone would help ensure the smooth flow of goods and strengthen the continuity of supply chains,” he said. According to the General Authority of Ports and Customs (GAPC), the total volume of containers handled at Saudi ports reached approximately 866,200 TEUs in October, compared to around 759,800 TEUs in the same month of 2025. The growth was driven by an 8.53 percent increase in inbound containers, which rose to approximately 305,600 TEUs from 281,600 TEUs, and a 4.83 percent increase in outbound containers, which climbed to approximately 282,900 TEUs from 269,900 TEUs. Meanwhile, transshipment containers declined by 10.54 percent to approximately 186,400 TEUs, compared to 208,400 TEUs, while transit containers totaled approximately 91,300 TEUs. In contrast, the total volume of cargo handled at Saudi ports fell by 11.7 percent to 22.36 million tons in October, compared to 25.32 million tons in the same month last year. This included 1.83 million tons of general cargo, 9.48 million tons of liquid bulk cargo, and 4.44 million tons of solid bulk cargo, while transit cargo amounted to 34,780 tons. As for maritime traffic, the number of vessels received at Saudi ports declined by 9.62 percent to approximately 1,500, compared to around 1,600 during the same period last year. Passenger traffic also decreased by 8.96 percent to approximately 87,600, compared to 96,200 passengers.The number of vehicles handled dropped by 41.46 percent to approximately 65,500, compared to around 111,900 in October last year. Conversely, the number of livestock received through the ports increased by 30.98 percent to approximately 725,100 head, compared to 553,600 head during the corresponding period in 2025.

items.title: Energy ministry: East-West Pipeline targeted in Madinah; operations remain unaffected
items.title_zh: 能源部：以麦地那为目标的东西管道；运营不受影响
items.summary: RIYADH — An official source at the Ministry of Energy stated that the East-West Pipeline in the Madinah region was targeted on Monday, November 9, resulting in a minor fire. Emergency response teams successfully brought the fire under control without any injuries or fatalities, while the pipeline's operations remained unaffected.The source explained that emergency response teams, along with specialized technical teams, immediately launched operations following the attack and took all necessary measures to secure the site and ensure its safety in accordance with approved safety procedures and emergency response plans.

items.title: Etimad launches fine installment payment service for private and non-profit establishments
items.title_zh: Etimad为私人和非营利机构推出罚款分期付款服务
items.summary: RIYADH — The National Center for Government Resource Systems (NCGR) announced the launch of the “Installment Requests for Violations” service for private- and non-profit-sector establishments through the Etimad platform. The new service enables establishments to apply for installment-based settlement of outstanding financial fines in accordance with approved procedures.The NCGR said that the service is designed to enable establishments to submit requests to pay outstanding financial fines in installments, facilitating access to the service in accordance with approved procedures. The service allows violators in the private and non-profit sectors to settle fines imposed by government agencies and recorded on the “Efaa” platform through installment payments. It aims to ease the financial burden of paying these fines while contributing to increased government revenue.

items.title: Hajj minister: Number of foreign Umrah pilgrims doubled in 3 years
items.title_zh: 朝觐部长：外国朝觐人数在3年内翻了一番
items.summary: JEDDAH — Minister of Hajj and Umrah Dr. Tawfiq Al-Rabiah said that the number of Umrah pilgrims arriving from outside the Kingdom increased from approximately 8.4 million in 2022 to 18 million in 2025. “During the same period, the number of visitors to Al-Rawdah Al-Sharifah at the Prophet's Mosque in Madinah rose from around 6 million to nearly 16 million. These achievements were made possible by continuous service development and the concerted efforts of the relevant authorities,” he said.The minister made the remarks while attending a ministerial session titled "Serving the Pilgrims: An Integrated National Ecosystem," on the second day of the sixth edition of the Hajj Conference and Exhibition in Jeddah on Monday. The session discussed the integration of efforts by governmental and executive bodies in serving the pilgrims, developing mechanisms for joint cooperation, and raising the level of preparedness for the 1448 AH Hajj season.Speakers at the session also included Minister of Tourism Ahmed Al-Khateeb; General Authority of Civil Aviation President Abdulaziz Al-Duailej, Director of Public Security Lt. Gen. Mohammed Al-Bassami; and Makkah Mayor Musaed Al-Dawood.Al-Rabiah pointed out that more than 60 government agencies are involved in the Hajj system, operating under approximately 600 annual operational plans. The Hajj Projects Management Office coordinates and aligns these plans, resolves potential overlaps, and monitors operational indicators through the Command and Control Center, thereby strengthening preparedness and enhancing the efficiency of services provided to the guests of God. Addressing the session, Minister of Tourism Al-Khateeb highlighted the ministry's role as a key partner in the system of serving the guests of God. He noted that the ministry has assumed responsibility for overseeing pilgrims' accommodation in coordination with the Ministry of Hajj and Umrah, while working to improve the quality of accommodation facilities. He revealed that approximately 400 buildings had been taken out of service for failing to meet safety and quality standards. Al-Khateeb announced the completion of licensing procedures for buildings designated to accommodate pilgrims during the Hajj season of 2027, as part of early preparations and planning.
